segments.title: Cold Open & Schedule Briefing
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens the broadcast, outlines tomorrow's eight-hour debate marathon (11am–7pm), discusses Biden's potential withdrawal, and previews RNC highlights and Munch & Crum coat shopping.

segments.title: RNC Night Four Highlights
segments.notes: Case reacts to MSNBC's RNC highlight reel: Trump's acceptance speech, Trump Jr.'s ear-hair commentary, Hulk Hogan's nine-minute promo (including 'Donald Dick J. Trump' flub and shirt tear), and Kid Rock's performance with awkward crowd shots.

segments.title: Kendall's Culture Corner: Kid Rock Influencer Drama
segments.notes: Kendelle appears with her theme music to explain the Brooke Schofield/Clinton Kane TikTok feud where Kane hysterically sobbed over Schofield saying she'd 'fuck the shit out of Kid Rock'; Case renames the segment 'KKKK' (Kendall's K-pop Kulture Korner).

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Interview with Chance Blanthal
segments.notes: Trent interviews Chance Blanthal, a sunglasses-wearing cult leader of 'Psydub' who mirrors Trent's speech patterns; Chance preaches aggressive self-interest, cutting lines, and monetizing followers, ending in a sleep-off standoff.

segments.title: Kissing Tutorials, Carrot Flute, Line Dance
segments.notes: Jeb studies kissing tutorials (Justice Cow's 'smush peck, lick, poke' method), practices on a plastic sheet while his father's soul haunts the workshop wood, watches Kevin Pariah make a carrot flute, and attempts a country line dance with limited success.

segments.title: Belulia Debut, Hogan vs. Savage, Coat Shopping
segments.notes: Munch and Crum introduce Crum's wife Belulia (married 38 years, Piggly Wiggly heiress, sex-forward); they debate Hulk Hogan vs. Macho Man; Belulia forces Munch to apologize; rushed Shein coat poll ends with gold blazer victory as Munch raids Bruce.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from a day off to preview tomorrow's eight-hour debate marathon and react to RNC night four highlights, including Hulk Hogan's 'Donald Dick J. Trump' flub and Kid Rock's performance. Kendelle debuts 'Kendall's Culture Corner' on an influencer feud involving Kid Rock. Trent interviews his sunglasses-wearing doppelgänger Chance Blanthal, leader of the 'Psydub' cult. Jeb Nogget struggles through kissing tutorials, a carrot flute build, and a line dance while his father's soul haunts the workshop wood. Munch & Crum introduce Crum's wife Belulia (Piggly Wiggly heiress, 38-year marriage), debate Hogan vs. Macho Man, and speed-run a Shein blazer purchase via flash poll — gold coat wins — before Munch raids Bruce.
